limitations: The dataset starts in 2017 and records initial issuance rather than construction progress.
Project value is an applicant estimate and may be zero, incomplete, revised or overlap related permits.
Classification is a disclosed text/category rule; AI specificity is not imputed.
Personal and precise location fields are excluded from the processed artifact.

publication_boundary.reason: Issued permits and declared project values indicate authorized activity, not realized quarterly expenditure or labour hours; text does not establish AI use.
